SELECT id, record_id, plate_no, lot_id, lot_name, lot_type, entry_gate, exit_gate, entry_time, exit_time, duration_min, user_type, space_no, pay_amount, discount, coupon, pay_method, is_holiday, is_workday_adjust, is_weekend, weekday, weather, temp_avg, wind_level
FROM park_record WHERE 1 = 1
AND plate_no LIKE CONCAT('%',#{parkRecord.plateNo},'%')
AND lot_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{parkRecord.lotName},'%')
AND user_type = #{parkRecord.userType}
AND space_no LIKE CONCAT('%',#{parkRecord.spaceNo},'%')
ORDER BY id DESC
